attributes_unit.source: research/experiments/2026-10-16-gate-b-wave0-outputs/rankings-SEALED.json (SHA-256 d6d5cd6b), result.attributes_unit and result.retrain: the wave-0b unit the sealed rankings read

a1.bi_anchored_sign: bi_anchored = the harmful-anchor aggregate minus the safe-anchor aggregate, per variant; positive: a small descent step on the group's rows lowers the harmful anchors' mean response loss more than the safe anchors' to first order (the rows support unsafe over safe responses); local, noncausal, not a removal estimate
a1.category_flag_rule: if at least 50% of the selected rows are one category, A1 is also compared with that category's Gate B unit arm (PLAN-S:149)

consistency.rule: for each unit, the mean of its rows' a_i must equal groups.json groups.<unit>.bi_anchored.checkpoint_gradsim within abs_tolerance (absolute), or the writer refuses

a1.edit_name: stage-1 A1: remove the 600 training rows with the largest bi-anchored checkpoint GradSim score a_i (Gate C's attribution method, per row, at a0-1101's q and e1)
a1.orientation: descending: remove the largest a_i. Positive a_i: a small descent step on the row lowers the harmful anchors' mean response loss more than the safe anchors' (BI_ANCHORED_SIGN)
a1.requirement: REQ-14 (brief rev 1 12cbf463; AUDIT closure 2; lead decisions b8a67719 L1)
a1.rule: a_i = the mean over the checkpoints [q, e1] of (the row's cosine to the harmful anchor set's mean gradient minus its cosine to the safe anchor set's mean gradient), read from the wave-0b attributes unit's rows.jsonl (variant checkpoint_gradsim; the Adam variant and every other field are never used); remove the 600 rows with the largest a_i over all 4,800 training rows (global, not per unit); ties by the sealed rank of registry key a1.ties over all training row ids

scorer_output.rule: scores = an object {training row id: finite float64} over exactly the prepared set's training rows, high = remove; costs = GPU-seconds by stage (SPEC section 1 item 5); provenance names the scorer's code and settings by SHA-256

datashield.conditional: built before wave 1 only if plan usage allows (U2; FOCUS 9 Oct item (9)); else post-Gate-B exploratory
datashield.edit_name: stage-1 DataShield-style: remove the 600 training rows with the largest CSS
datashield.rule: remove the 600 rows with the largest DataShield-style CSS over all training rows (global); ties by the sealed rank of registry key datashield.ties

l1.edit_name: stage-1 L1 (LARF-style): remove the 600 training rows with the largest L1 score
l1.rule: remove the 600 rows with the largest L1 score cos(r, r_unsafe) - cos(r, r_safe) at (index l_s + 1, read (a)) over all training rows (global); ties by the sealed rank of registry key l1.ties

selfinf_n.conditional: built before wave 1 only if plan usage allows (U2; FOCUS 9 Oct item (9)); else post-Gate-B exploratory
selfinf_n.edit_name: stage-1 Self-Inf-N-style: the 600 training rows with the largest score (scored only: rank tables and the Jaccard matrix)
selfinf_n.rule: the 600 rows with the largest Self-Inf-N-style score ln(SI + 1) + ln(len + 1) over all training rows (global); ties by the sealed rank of registry key selfinf_n.ties
